name: Samuel
camp_role: distiller of the camp's grog and rum

personality.en: Cheerful, always a little drunk, proud of his recipes. Generous with a drink, stingy with his secrets.
personality.pl: Pogodny, zawsze trochę wstawiony, dumny ze swoich receptur. Hojny w nalewaniu, skąpy w zdradzaniu sekretów.

speech_style.en: Jovial, hiccups, praises his grog, toasts often.
speech_style.pl: Wesoło, czka, wychwala swój grog, często wznosi toasty.

en: Here, try this. Best grog this side of the sea!
pl: Masz, spróbuj. Najlepszy grog po tej stronie morza!

relations.greg: Greg loves his grog, so Samuel is safe.

persuasion: Praise for his grog, or bringing him ingredients.
